title: Cheryl R NDE 9512
content: The CAT Scan dye was injected and I said aloud that I felt funny. The nurses heard me and jumped, but I was immediately in a dark void. It was not scary but very comforting. I was comfortable and knew I was dead. It was fine because all my worries were completely gone. I felt like I was reclining in the most comfortable place. There were two feminine beings behind me. I did not turn to look at them but they were loving and concerned. They seemed a bit confused as to why I was there. I looked around a little and saw small starlike lights moving by me and I knew they were others who had died but they were moving on. I then remembered that I had just had a baby and wondered to myself if she would be okay without me. The beings seemed relieved to have something to do. They assured me that my little daughter, Wendy, would be fine, and I was instantly seeing her at the babysitters. There were three ladies together looking at her and caring for her. I was satisfied. Then I was back in my body. I shouted out, 'I’m back!' The nurse standing by me said something snarky so I stayed quiet, and they proceeded with the scan. No one ever mentioned that I lost consciousness or that anything had happened. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: October 1976 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Allergic Reaction Life threatening event, but not clinical death I was having a CT scan with contrast. As soon as the dye was injected, I felt funny then immediately I was in a black void How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I went to the babysitter’s house and saw everything from the corner of the ceiling looking down I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I was totally at ease and in wonderment At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was in the void Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I’m nearsighted and have been all my life, but I was not nearsighted there Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There was nothing said out loud, but communication was instantaneous Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, but the facts have not been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain I was in a dark void with lights moving past me that were other souls, I seemed to know instinctively what they were and that to others I looked the same, but I wasn’t moving as fast as others. Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I felt that the two Female beings were related to me Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Uncertain The other souls were small lights. I didn’t see any other lights Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It was a dark void, clearly not of earth What emotions did you feel during the experience? Joy, comfort, absence of any worry Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Protestant Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Protestant I don’t attend church but I have strong belief in God Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I never thought of an in between place before Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin As I said before, there were two Female beings who seemed familiar to me, but they were always behind me and out of my sight. They seemed relieved that they could show me my baby and made sure I knew that she would be fine Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I was still me and I knew I was dead Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life It took several years to put the experience in words Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Just that amazing feeling Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Several years Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. The sights and feelings were very vivid and unlike any other What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I lived it. Also now, I’ve heard many others tell their experiences, so I feel validated At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: Two feminine beings were sensed behind her; she did not turn to look. They felt loving/concerned and seemed confused why she was there; she felt they were related to her.

environment.environment_other_detail: Dark/black void; small star-like lights moving by that she understood as other souls who had died and were moving on.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Allergic reaction to CT/CAT scan contrast dye injection during a scan.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She reported being in a dark void; sensed two feminine beings; perceived other souls as small star-like lights; perceived her baby at the babysitter’s; then returned to her body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Immediate transition to a dark void; later remote viewing of her baby at the babysitter’s; then abrupt return to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived other souls as small star-like lights moving past her in a dark void; two feminine beings stayed behind her and out of sight; instantaneous viewing of her baby at the babysitter’s.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was immediately in a dark void.”; “I was comfortable and knew I was dead.”; “I’m back!”
